The same burst shape appears on 10 other customers' cards (C00466-K1, C01890-K1, C02265-K1, C03633-K1) in the prior 30 days, so it is coordinated rather than card testing (no small probes) or a known category. sar.narrative: Between 2016-12-03 12:00 and 2016-12-03 12:30, 4 transaction(s) totalling $1,884.76 were made on card(s) C05423-K1 belonging to customer C05423. The activity comprised 4 online transaction(s) under product code(s) C, in no billing region recorded. Online transactions came from device profile(s) UNK | UNK | safari generic | UNK; UNK | UNK | mobile safari generic | UNK; Windows | UNK | chrome 63.0 | UNK. The purchases were placed within minutes of each other, each just below a $500 threshold, a pattern that avoids single-transaction limits. The same burst shape was found on 11 cards of 11 different customers in the preceding 30 days, indicating coordinated abuse (policy R9). The amount exceeds the $1,000 reporting threshold. Total suspicious amount: $1,884.76. Actions recommended: BLOCK_CARD, CREATE_CASE, FILE_REPORT, ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST.
